quotes.text: …We had an amazing time! Within minutes of our first cast off we had two fish in the boat – a suckerfish, my son caught and a King fish. Within moments of that we had a Sail Fish on the line, that took some time to get in – but definitely a once in a lifetime trip for this family from Nebraska!
